race.comment: DUG ANOTHER HOLE (2) is the one to beat after a strong second in BM72+ company at this track, beaten just under a length despite being unwanted in the market. His record at this venue is consistently solid, Brad Parnham has a long, productive association with him, and the easier assignment gives him the right platform. PLEASE MIZTER (7) brings the winning form, having made it three in a row at Kalgoorlie and looked to have something in hand beating Lendanear, though this is a stronger meeting than those BM58+ wins. DEFENDING (3) has not fired this campaign, yet his distance profile, prior track-and-trip win and stronger historical ratings keep him in the minor-winning mix if he sharpens up. PLAYING SOLO (13) is next best.
